wpPortfolio.title: A THOUSAND EYES
wpPortfolio.content: I collaborated with illustrator Ray Smith to create an interactive aquarium for our pop-up exhibition in Clerkenwell, London. Projections were shot onto every wall of a darkened room in order to make visitors feel immersed in a world on strange sea creatures. We also held sea-themed talks courtesy of the Zoological Society of London.
